name: Comparative Lit (PMn)

rules.name: Completion requirements

children.name: Two non-native languages (one for graduate courses, one to read an author in the original)
Three graduate courses in the department of the second literature
One of the COMPLIT courses a seminar in literary theory or criticism
Two of the three COMPLIT courses originate in a department other than your own

rules.notes:
• A knowledge of at least two non-native languages:

• One non-native language sufficient to qualify for graduate-level courses in that language

• A second non-native language sufficient to read a significant author in the original language

• A minimum of six graduate courses:

• Three graduate courses must be in the department of the second literature

• Except for students in the Asian languages, students must choose a second literature outside the department of their primary literature

• Three graduate courses must be in the Department of Comparative Literature, including:

• A seminar in literary theory or criticism

• At least two of the three courses in Comparative Literature should originate in a department other than the one where the student is completing their degree

grading:
PhD students in the department must take required courses for a letter grade if available, and they are expected to earn a grade of B+ or better in each course taken. Any grade of B or below is considered to be less than satisfactory. Grades of B or below are reviewed by faculty, and the following actions may be taken:

• The grade stands, and the student’s academic performance is monitored to ensure that satisfactory progress is being made

• The student may be required to retake the course
The principal conditions for continued registration of a graduate student are the timely and satisfactory completion of the university, department, and program requirements for the degree and fulfillment of minimum progress requirements. Failure to meet these requirements results in corrective measures, including a written warning, and/or the possible dismissal from the program.
reviewNotes: The audit checks three graduate COMPLIT courses and 20 units in all, every course letter graded where a letter grade is offered. You move in by hand the three graduate courses in your second literature's department, and mark the literary theory seminar, the two non-native languages, and that two of the COMPLIT courses originate in a department other than your own.
